{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Reflection;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageOnResolverAndFormatterCache_AndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public partial class OuterClass\n    {\n        [CompositeResolver(typeof(StandardResolver))]\n        public partial class NestedInClassResolver\n        {\n        }\n    }\n\n    public partial struct OuterStruct\n    {\n        [CompositeResolver(typeof(StandardResolver))]\n        public partial class NestedInStructResolver\n        {\n        }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            generators: new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n\n        string classResolverGenerated = generatedSources\n            .Single(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class NestedInClassResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            .SourceText.ToString();\n        string structResolverGenerated = generatedSources\n            .Single(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class NestedInStructResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            .SourceText.ToString();\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", classResolverGenerated, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", structResolverGenerated, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> compileDiagnostics = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(compileDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = outputCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        Assembly compiledAssembly = Assembly.Load(peStream.ToArray());\n\n        AssertResolverAndCacheHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage(compiledAssembly, \"TestNamespace.OuterClass+NestedInClassResolver\");\n        AssertResolverAndCacheHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage(compiledAssembly, \"TestNamespace.OuterStruct+NestedInStructResolver\");\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertResolverAndCacheHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage(Assembly assembly, string resolverMetadataName)\n    {\n        Type? resolverType = assembly.GetType(resolverMetadataName);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverType);\n        Assert.True(typeof(IFormatterResolver).IsAssignableFrom(resolverType), $\"'{resolverMetadataName}' should implement IFormatterResolver.\");\n        Assert.True(\n            resolverType!.IsDefined(typeof(ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute), inherit: false),\n            $\"Nested resolver '{resolverMetadataName}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n        Type? formatterCacheType = resolverType.GetNestedType(\"FormatterCache`1\", BindingFlags.NonPublic);\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheType);\n        Assert.True(\n            formatterCacheType!.IsDefined(typeof(ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute), inherit: false),\n            $\"Nested FormatterCache<T> of '{resolverMetadataName}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n    }\n}\n"}
